artworks.title: Tree Study, Fontainebleau
artworks.description: The image shows an upward view of twisted branches of large trees in a dense forest setting. The trees dominate the scene, with intricate dark silhouettes contrasting against a faintly lit sky. The sepia-toned light filters through the canopy. The bark and undergrowth closest to us have a rough and textured appearance. The color palette consists of rich browns and deep shadows, creating a timeless and mysterious woodland environment. The interplay of light and shadow accentuates the complexity and age of the forest, with twisting branches receding into the distance.

artworks.title: Road and Trees with Hoarfrost
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow path flanked by tall, leafless trees creating a tunnel effect. The path leads into the distance, lined with trees that gradually diminish in size. The scene features a sepia tone, giving a monochromatic feel with shades of brown and beige. The path is lined with undergrowth and shrubs, and mist or haze obscures the end of the path in the distance.

artworks.title: Turkey: Scutari Cemetery
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 16.7 x 17.5 cm (6 9/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated position looking down a gentle slope towards a wooded area. Tall trees of varying heights dominate the scene, including cypress trees. A winding path or stone wall can be seen running horizontally across the scene, leading into the woods. The image appears to have been captured using a photographic technique as there are no visible brushstrokes. The color palette is muted and in sepia tones, giving the image an antique look. The ground appears uneven with scattered shadows, likely from the trees. The background is filled with a thick canopy of trees, creating a sense of depth and enclosure.

artworks.title: Grenade, Alhambra, Porte d'Entree de la Forteresse
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view looking up a path towards a large ancient stone structure with a prominent archway. The structure casts a shadow on its left side, indicating the light source. The image has a clear photographic style, highlighting the weathered stone textures in sepia tones. The path is flanked by stone ruins on the left and a row of trees on the right, leading towards the main structure. The background sky is bright with few clouds, enhancing the grandeur of the architecture.

artworks.title: Woman Holding a Dead Bird, Surrey County Asylum
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her torso and head visible. She is looking slightly off to the side, with her body turned at an angle. Her facial expressions suggest a relaxed demeanor, and she has light-colored hair styled in a long braid hanging over one shoulder. She wears a checkered dress with a high collar, a patterned scarf tied around her neck, a woven straw hat on her head, and a shawl draped over one shoulder. She holds a small bird in her hands. The background is a plain, curtain-like fabric.

artworks.title: Thebes: Karnak, Portique de Temple de Khons
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 21 x 16.5 cm (8 1/4 x 6 1/2 in.)
support: 44.7 x 31.1 cm (17 5/8 x 12 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a photograph of ancient architectural ruins featuring ornate columns and carvings. The image captures a section of historical ruins showing two large stone columns standing next to each other. Each column is intricately carved with detailed patterns and hieroglyphics. Above the columns is a stone lintel with more carvings extending across it. The space between the columns reveals a partially obstructed view into another section of the ruins. The ground is sandy and uneven with debris scattered around. The tones of the photograph are in a monochromatic sepia, with shadows adding depth to the architectural details.

artworks.title: Windermere
artworks.description: The image shows a wide landscape with undulating hills and mountains in the distance, a calm body of water reflecting the sky, clusters of trees, a winding path, and a color palette of soft sepia tones.

artworks.title: Cemetery, Cathcart's Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a low angle perspective, focusing on a ridge where two figures are holding up a flag. The terrain below is rough and dotted with stones, graves marked by crosses and headstones. The scene has a muted and monochromatic color palette, reminiscent of an old photograph. A solitary figure stands below the ridge facing the flag, while the background shows a horizon merging into a blank sky. The composition is clear and detailed, capturing the elements in the frame with precision.

artworks.title: The Pyramids of Dahshoor From the East
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with a high horizon line. A hill on the left side casts a shadow on its slopes. In the distance on the right, there is the Bent Pyramid. Near the foreground, three figures sit on the ground next to an animal. Another person leads a different animal in the distance. The image is dominated by sepia tones, with shades of light brown and sandy hues.

artworks.title: The Statues of the Plain, Thebes
artworks.description: The image shows the Colossi of Memnon, two massive seated statues of Pharaoh Amenhotep III, made of light-colored sandstone. The statues are eroded but retain faint details like hieroglyphs. People nearby appear small in comparison, highlighting the statues' grandiosity. The statues are in an open area with barren hills in the background.

artworks.title: Landscape, Montebello
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees reaching towards the sky. A stream flows under a bridge-like structure in the foreground. Trees with pruned branches line the landscape, creating a rhythmic pattern as they recede into the distance. The overall color palette is a monochromatic sepia tone. The image is a photograph, capturing natural textures and tones in a soft, muted contrast.

artworks.title: Edfu-Sculptures and Inscriptions on Oriental Face
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 23.3 x 29.9 cm (9 3/16 x 11 3/4 in.)
support: 47.4 x 61.9 cm (18 11/16 x 24 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a large stone wall sculpture with intricate carvings and reliefs. The subject appears to be ancient Egyptian figures with distinctive profiles, traditional headdresses, and attire. The sculpture features hieroglyphic inscriptions carved into the stone. The material is stone with a natural brownish-gray tone. The figures and symbols are depicted in a flat, two-dimensional style typical of ancient Egyptian art. The backdrop shows signs of erosion and slight deterioration. The figures are larger than life, towering in size. The composition highlights the grandeur and detailed artistry of ancient Egyptian architecture and iconography.

artworks.title: Hell's Half Acre, Firehole River
artworks.description: The image shows a geyser erupting in a flat landscape, with a river nearby. A dense forest and hills can be seen in the background, and the color palette is sepia-toned with earthy browns and muted grays accentuating the contrast between the ground and vegetation.

artworks.title: Soldier Thrown in Air
artworks.description: This black-and-white photograph shows a group of men in dark shirts with dark, wide-brimmed hats. Everyone is gathered outdoors near some pointed gray tents, and they appear to be in a loose circle, holding a tarp or cloth stretched out between them. One man appears to float in the air above the group, his body horizontal, facing the right. The men below him are all smiling widely, some appearing to laugh. In the bottom left corner, one man looks back over his shoulder at us, a white cigarette in his mouth. Most of the men appear to have light skin, although some are in shadow. The sky behind the tents and floating man is bright white.

artworks.title: Study of the Spires of Lichfield Cathedral
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a gothic-style cathedral with three tall, pointed spires against a darkened sky. The cathedral features detailed stonework, arched windows, and intricate designs. Two buildings frame the cathedral in the foreground. The contrast highlights the architectural details against the dark background.

artworks.title: Bas-Bréau, Forest of Fontainebleau
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland path with tall trees on both sides. The viewpoint is from the ground looking straight ahead along the narrowing path. The canopy of leaves overhead nearly obscures the high horizon line. The tree trunks cast shadows, and sunlight filters through the leaves onto the ground. The photograph lacks distinct brushstrokes giving it a painterly effect. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, with shades of deep browns and soft golds. In the distance, the path continues into the forest.

artworks.title: Ange Portant un Cadran Solaire, à l'Eglise de Chartres
artworks.description: The sculpture features an angelic figure with wings partially spread out, affixed to a stone wall. The angel holds a sundial with a triangular gnomon casting a shadow. The figure wears flowing robes, a decorative halo-like feature above the head, and stands on a short pedestal. The sculpture is made of stone, blending into the same-colored wall backdrop with a rough texture. The natural, earthy tone of the stone appears weathered and aged. The sculpture is part of an architectural structure, with a small arched feature above the angel’s head, suggesting integration into the building's design.

artworks.title: Salle des Cariatides, au Musée du Louvre
artworks.description: The image shows a hall filled with classical sculptures, mostly human figures. The sculptures are light-colored, possibly made from marble. Several statues of draped female figures stand symmetrically against the walls, while a nude male statue stands on a pedestal in the foreground. The hall features architectural elements like columns and arched ceilings adorned with intricate carvings. Light streams in from the left, illuminating the space and highlighting the detailed features of the sculptures.

artworks.title: The Seine from the Pont du Carrousel Looking towards Notre Dame
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from the bank of a river with historic buildings across the water. A cobblestone street runs alongside trees and small structures, leading the eye towards distant buildings and bridges. The horizon is marked by the cityscape's architectural silhouette, including the prominent dome of an ornate building. A bridge spans the river, connecting to more distant buildings. The photograph is in sepia tones, creating a vintage feel. The color palette includes earthy browns and muted grays, contributing to a timeless and historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bois de Boulogne
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water reflecting trees along its banks. Two trees stand near the water's edge, with sparse branches. The horizon sits low, with an expansive sky blending into distant foliage. A small bridge crosses the water. The image has a sepia tone with a color palette of browns and grays. The sky has a gentle gradient, contrasting with the defined silhouettes of trees and landscape.

artworks.title: Rue des Lombards, from the rue des Lavandières Sainte-Opportune
artworks.description: The image is a black and white photograph of an urban street scene. The perspective leads the viewer down a central cobblestone street flanked by tall buildings. The horizon is formed by the converging street, with buildings extending into the distance. Architectural details like shuttered windows and facades suggest a classic European cityscape. Signage on buildings displays business names and addresses. A small pushcart is parked by the sidewalk, and a horse-drawn carriage is visible further down the street. The monochrome palette adds a timeless quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Plate Number 34. Walking and carrying a 15-lb. basket on head, hands raised
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing sequential frames of a figure walking with a basket on its head. The image displays different stages of the walking motion in each frame. The figure is seen in profile in the top row and from the back in the bottom row, set against a grid background. The sequence highlights the dynamic movement, focusing on posture and balance needed to carry the basket. The study captures the rhythm and continuity of the walk, emphasizing movement and anatomy in a scientific manner.

artworks.title: Asile Impérial de Vincennes: le 15 Août, le Salut à l'Empereur
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a ceremonial gathering in front of a grand building entrance. The image shows a group of individuals arranged in a semi-circle facing towards the camera. Some are standing on the steps leading to a large arched doorway. The building's facade is detailed with brickwork and decorative elements around the doorway. Many individuals are holding or waving hats in the air. The crowd includes people in various attires such as dark suits and lighter clothing. The photograph captures a historical moment and the architecture and clothing styles indicate the time period. A gravel path is visible leading up to the steps, and the overall tone of the image is sepia.

artworks.title: Asile Impérial de Vincennes: la Lingerie
artworks.description: Two women are shown standing in a hallway lined with shelves filled with papers. Both women wear traditional nun habits and appear engaged in their surroundings. The hallway is well-lit with sunlight streaming in from windows, casting shadows.
